main_text.p: rodoxa & fidei catholica contraria. His iterum respondit Prosper & dixit illos calumniatores Augustinum celeberrimi nominis virum, promptius culpare quàm nosse. Compellarunt etiam Prosper & Hilarius Cælestinum primum Pontificem Romanum, & rogarunt ut doctrinæ Augustinianæ patrocinium susciperet, quod Papa fecit in epistola ad quosdam Galliarum Episcopos, in qua Augustini sententiam & Prosperi ac Hilarii defensionem approbavit.

Haud multò post, Faustus Abbas Rhegiensis Semipelagianorum opinioni sese associans doctrinam ab Augustino propositam, & à Prospero, Hilario & Cælestino defensam, publico scripto damnavit & hærefin appellavit primus. Gennadius Massiliensis, qui vixit A. D. 490. Fausti doctrinam laudavit, & Augustinianam doctrinam (suppresso Augustini nomine) hærefin Præde-

page.notes: Catchword "Præde-" appears at the foot right; it is the start of the next page's word and is included in the text above as the last word. Page number "382" printed top left. Running head "Castigatio Paral." printed top right.
